claims.statement: The audit-only HAK-009 linter rejects provider-bound check evidence whose subject, plan, terminal receipt, execution run/attempt, workflow, plan obligation, or provider job identity/metadata drifts from the exact source lineage.

Strict conformance consumption requires every Passed required check and negative case to reference an exact digest-bound ProviderBound evidence record with successful provider job and step conclusions.
A provider-bound record with a terminal failure remains structurally valid negative execution evidence and is not rewritten as missing evidence.

HAK-009 tooling preserves the distinction between ProviderBound records and stronger cryptographically attested bundles; this tranche does not label ordinary provider metadata as cryptographically attested.

required_checks.description: Resolve, checkout, and assert the exact PR head.
Compile inherited HAK evidence/interpretation tooling and scripts/hak_check_evidence_lint.py under Python 3.12.
Lint the HAK-009 machine-readable qualification plan.
Validate HAK-009 schema syntax and representative documents with Draft 2020-12 jsonschema.
Run focused HAK-009 linter and schema regression suites.

required_negative_cases: provider job missing from terminal qualification receipt
provider job metadata mismatch with terminal qualification receipt
Passed conformance with detached evidence reference
schema accepts missing qualification receipt digest

independence.claim_interpretation: limited to HAK-009 tooling behavior; provider cryptographic authenticity is explicitly outside these claims
